author: jeosprite
body:
I am being banned for hacks, but I can promise I've never used hacks or plan too. I'm not sure why I was blocked, but I feel it was a mistake because I was playing the game well enough it could've been considered hacks or maybe my internet lagged. I would really like to come back on the server to play with my friends, who also play without hacks. I really miss playing Destroy the Monument..

~JeoSprite~
